title: OKX Promo Code for New Users: What Really Exists

thumbnail.image_prompt: a surprised young woman looking at her smartphone in a bright living room, natural light, candid moment

media.image_prompt: a young woman reacting with curiosity to her smartphone in a bright living room

lines.show: For new users, what people call an OKX promo code is usually a referral code you enter at sign-up.
Promotions themselves live inside the app, in the rewards and campaign pages.
Let's clear up the common myth, then look at where real offers are shown.
The myth goes like this: somewhere online there's a special promo code that pays a fixed amount of cash.
Posts like that get a lot of clicks.
But what they usually share is a regular referral code with a big promise attached.

scenes.title: Offers are set by OKX
scenes.text: Not by whoever posts the code.

lines.show: Here's the fact: the new user program is set by OKX.
The person sharing a code doesn't decide what you receive.
So any post that promises a specific payout should be checked against the app.
Real promotions show up in a few places.
The rewards page inside the app.
The campaign or events section, where time-limited programs appear.
And OKX's official announcements.

scenes.title: Coupons in private chats: a red flag
scenes.text: Real offers don't arrive by private message.

lines.show: If a stranger sends you a coupon in a private message, treat it as a warning sign.
Real offers appear inside your account, not in a chat from someone you don't know.

scenes.title: Terms change often
scenes.text: Read the page on the day you join.

lines.show: Programs change and can differ by country.
So read the terms on the day you sign up, not in an old screenshot.
So what do you actually type?
Open sign-up in the official app.
Find the referral or invite code field.
Type the code there.
Then check the rewards page once your account is ready.

scenes.title: The code to type
scenes.text: In the referral field at sign-up

lines.show: This channel's code is XOACPQFC.
Type it in the referral field, not in a coupon box.

scenes.title: If OKX is available where you live
scenes.text: Type the code when you sign up

lines.show: If OKX is available where you live, use XOACPQFC at sign-up and check the rewards page for current offers.
Thanks for watching.
